title: Akiyama Mizuki — Nightcord at 25:00〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Female Student
rows.Line: Mizuki! I haven't seen you in forever!

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line:
You actually came to school.
Is it because the exams are soon?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heya.
You look like you could go for a nap.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Did he just give me the stink eye?

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Unlike most of us, he's not used to you, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I don't want people to just get used to me, but to try to understand me. Is that too much to ask?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Why can't they just accept me for who I am?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oof, I'm finally back.
Now, let's log in to Nightcord!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What's up, Amia? You sound tired.
Is it because of school?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, it was exhausting! I had P.E. in the afternoon, and that was a real killer.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Say, did something happen while you were at school?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, I didn't notice you were online, K.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I just set my status to offline.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Are you guys talking about a new song?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, Yuki. We've got the full squad now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <We were just asking Amia if something's wrong.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But since it's come up, let me first ask you guys, what do you think about me?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I think you're more stylish rather than cute, even though our taste in fashion's different.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Is it, really? Didn't you absolutely love the outfit I modded for you the other day?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But that's not what we're talking about now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You follow your own sense of what's right for you, and that makes you look cool and confident.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I think it's this feistiness that's the most distinctive about you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You said something similar to me when you were inviting me to the group.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (How could I forget that there actually are people who naturally accept me without me having to fight for it?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hehe. So we all agree that I'm cute and stylish♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You sound like yourself again, annoying as usual.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Let's work on something we can only do when we're all together! We have until Enanan's got to go to her night classes♪>
